verdict.rationale: Data-training opt-outs are a fair privacy question for a SaaS analytics and experimentation platform, so the axis applies. However, the pack has no Statsig policy or control preventing customer data from being used to train AI models. Warehouse Native hosting and Session Replay privacy filters are adjacent data-handling features, not an AI-training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
